description_en: Reboots (shuts down and then starts) Cloud Phone instances
description_zh: 重启（先关机再开机）云手机实例
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic reboot-android-instances-in-group --android-instance-ids acp-sgicbcdadjs0000 --force-stop false --sale-mode Instance --ignore-param-validation true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RebootAndroidInstancesInGroup

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcefully reboot the instances. If a Cloud Phone instance cannot be shut down because of system or network errors, you can force a reboot. This operation may cause data loss
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制重启。当云手机遇到系统、网络等异常原因导致无法关机时，可选择强制重启（可能会丢失未保存数据）
parameters.name: force_stop
